exec("import os
import pathlib
import sys

roots = []
for env_var in ("ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_ROOT", "AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT", "CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT"):
    env = os.environ.get(env_var)
    if env:
        roots.append(pathlib.Path(env))

home = pathlib.Path.home()
for pattern in (
    ".gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/cache/*/paideia/*",
    ".gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/paideia",
    ".codex/plugins/cache/*/paideia/*",
    ".codex/.tmp/marketplaces/*/plugins/paideia",
):
    roots.extend(home.glob(pattern))

for root in roots:
    mcp = root / "paideia-mcp"
    if (mcp / "paideia_mcp" / "bootstrap.py").exists():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(mcp))
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit(
        "paideia-mcp: cannot locate paideia_mcp package"
    )

from paideia_mcp.bootstrap import main

main()")
